Website: own domain, https://www.brentwoodphysicaltherapy.com/ , built on Weebly/Square Online. It is live and current - all 29 pages in its sitemap return HTTP 200, the sitemap's lastmod is 20 Aug 2026, the footer reads '(c) COPYRIGHT 2026' and the blog has posts from May, June, July and August 2026.

NO PRICES PUBLISHED ANYWHERE ON THEIR SITE, so prices_published is false, items is empty, price_note is null and source_url is null. Every one of the 29 sitemap pages was read and searched for dollar amounts and for the words price, rate, fee, cost, cash pay, self pay and package; there is no fee schedule, no evaluation price, no visit rate and no package pricing. The guessed price pages /rates.html, /pricing.html, /prices.html, /cash-pay.html, /fees.html, /self-pay.html, /packages.html, /cost.html and /memberships.html all return HTTP 404.

CASH PAY EXISTS BUT IS UNPRICED: their FAQ page says 'We also have affordable cash pay programs' with no amount. Their insurance page says the team 'can help verify your coverage, explain your costs upfront, and handle billing', again with no figures. So a cash-pay rate exists to be asked for, but they publish none.

INSURANCE (not cash-pay only): the insurance page says they are 'in network with many major insurances as well as worker's compensation, Medicare, and auto insurance' and 'also contracted with John Muir HMO, Hill Physicians HMO, and Affinity HMO'. The FAQ page says 'in network with nearly all major insurances as well as worker's compensation, Medicare, and auto insurance' and names John Muir HMO only - a small wording difference between their own two pages, not a real contradiction. They bill insurance directly, deductible/co-pay/co-insurance is due at the time of service, and they accept cash, check, Visa and MasterCard. The patient demographic form they host adds 'WE DO NOT BILL THIRD PARTY AUTO CLAIM'.

THE ONLY DOLLAR FIGURE ON THE WHOLE SITE is a penalty, not a service price, so it is deliberately not in items: the 'No Show Policies' PDF they host (/uploads/1/3/0/4/13046685/missed_appointments_patient_signature.docx_1.pdf) says 'A late cancel or no-show will result in a $60 charge', needs 24 hours' notice, counts arriving more than 15 minutes late as a missed appointment, and warns that more than three missed or canceled appointments can result in patient dismissal.

CLINICIANS, from their own team page: Dominick Gabor, MPT (Owner), Derek Vandersloot, MS, PT (Owner) and Tori Heimlich, DPT. Their bio pages add: Dominick has a Master's in Physical Therapy from CSU Long Beach and lives in Brentwood; Derek has a Master's from UC San Francisco (1998) and has been an APTA-certified Clinical Specialist in Orthopedics (OCS) since 2002; Tori has a DPT from University of the Pacific and a B.S. in Kinesiology from San Jose State.

HOURS: the home page publishes 'Open 7am-7pm Monday - Friday. Saturdays 8am-4pm!' - the only hours they publish. It says nothing about Sunday, so the record leaves Sunday out rather than asserting they are closed. Their Instagram (as transcribed) publishes no hours, so there is nothing to contradict.

CONTACT: phone (925) 466-5550 and fax (925) 466-3880 on the home page; the contact page repeats the phone and truncates the fax to 'Fax: (925)'. The appointment page says texting 925-466-5550 is the fastest way for returning patients and is also how to cancel. Email info@brentwoodphysicaltherapy.com is published on the home and careers pages (obfuscated by Cloudflare email protection and decoded from the page's own data). Address, phone and the Instagram address '2200 Sand Creek Rd, Ste F' agree; the site writes it '2200 Sand Creek Rd., Ste F' with ZIP 94513.

Booking: there is no self-serve online booking and no prices behind a booking flow. New patients fill in a request form at /brentwood-physical-therapy-appointment.html and the clinic calls back; /talk-to-a-pt.html offers a choice of 'A comprehensive, hour long evaluation', 'An in-person 15 minute consultation' or 'A 15 minute phone consultation', none of them priced and none said to be free. No form was submitted and no appointment was requested. The 'PAY BILL' link goes to their patient portal at https://sanramonpt.patient.sprypt.com/home , which was not opened or logged into.

Relationship to another clinic, which explains several pages: the site says the clinic is 'From the trusted team behind San Ramon Valley Physical Therapy, serving the East Bay for over 40 years' and 'Built on the foundation of San Ramon Valley Physical Therapy - serving the East Bay since 1985', and links http://sanramonvalleypt.com . Note the two different vintages on their own pages ('over 40 years' vs 'since 1985'). Several inherited pages still speak as San Ramon Valley PT rather than Brentwood: /telerehab.html ('during this time of social distancing', 'Current SRVPT Patients'), /trx.html, and all five hosted new-patient PDFs, which carry the San Ramon Valley Physical Therapy letterhead and its Danville and San Ramon addresses and phone numbers, not the Brentwood ones. Worth flagging to the owner.

Claims on their own pages, useful for copy: one-on-one care with a licensed physical therapist at every visit; 60-minute evaluations; appointments available within the same week; locally owned, not a corporate chain; they handle insurance billing. Service area given as Brentwood, Oakley, Antioch, Discovery Bay and Byron (the meta description says Brentwood, Oakley and Discovery Bay). Direct access: under CA AB 1000 most PPO patients can be seen for 12 visits or 45 days without a doctor's referral, and they still accept referrals from MDs, DOs, chiropractors and podiatrists.

The site publishes no social media links at all (only tweet-this buttons on blog posts), so the Instagram handle is the one supplied in the brief. https://www.instagram.com/brentwoodphysicaltherapy/ returned HTTP 200 but only an empty JavaScript app shell, so nothing was taken from it.

Name: 'Brentwood Rehab & Performance Physical Therapy' in the site's body copy and footer, 'BRENTWOOD R&P PHYSICAL THERAPY' in the page title and logo alt text, 'Brentwood Rehab & Performance' on the About and Services pages, 'BRPPT' throughout. Instagram uses 'Brentwood Rehab & Performance PT'. name_exact uses the longest form the site itself writes.
